topic: RSI overbought/oversold strategy backtest across 4300 trades
summary: A backtest of an RSI strategy using length-20 RSI signals (cross above 70 long, cross below 30 short) filtered by a 200-period EMA and ATR-based stop losses. The test covers 10 assets across 30-minute, 1-hour, and daily timeframes using 24 months of data from December 2022 to December 2024, totaling ~4,300 trades. Results show the strategy was unprofitable on the 30-minute frame (–36% net), modestly profitable on the 1-hour frame (+172% net, 53% win rate), and marginally profitable on the daily frame (+8%). The presenter concludes the strategy lacks consistency across timeframes and suggests adding filters to improve robustness.
